title: M83: The Southern Pinwheel
explanation:
# M83: The Southern Pinwheel Galaxy

Twelve million light-years away, the stunning spiral galaxy M83 twirls like a cosmic pinwheel, its elegant arms traced by dark dust and brilliant blue star clusters, while glowing red nebulae (giant clouds where new stars are being born) sprinkle the spiral like thousands of rubies. Though smaller than our own Milky Way at just 40,000 light-years across, M83's core blazes with intense X-ray energy from a violent past—evidence of countless black holes and neutron stars left behind from a tremendous burst of star formation.
